objective: Auditar exclusivamente ORIGEN 2026-10-01 a 2026-10-14 para localizar el exceso del detalle frente al KPI correcto. El total canónico Runtime/Base 2026-10-01 a 2026-10-15 es 978884.83 y el usuario confirma que ese es el valor correcto. No modificar datos ni código. Reportar por día venta/tickets/pax de Runtime y detalle histórico, y delta exacto.

queries.name: origen_daily_runtime_vs_detail_oct01_14
queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT fecha_operacion,numero_ticket,SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(importe_neto,0) ELSE 0 END) AS venta_ticket,MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(pax,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-14' GROUP BY fecha_operacion,numero_ticket), ds AS (SELECT fecha_operacion,CAST(SUM(venta_ticket) AS decimal(18,2)) AS detalle_ventas,COUNT(*) AS detalle_tickets,SUM(pax_ticket) AS detalle_pax FROM d GROUP BY fecha_operacion) SELECT CAST(r.fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha,CAST(r.ventas_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS runtime_ventas,r.tickets_total AS runtime_tickets,r.pax_total AS runtime_pax,ISNULL(ds.detalle_ventas,0) AS detalle_ventas,ISNULL(ds.detalle_tickets,0) AS detalle_tickets,ISNULL(ds.detalle_pax,0) AS detalle_pax,CAST(ISNULL(ds.detalle_ventas,0)-ISNULL(r.ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS delta_ventas,ISNULL(ds.detalle_tickets,0)-ISNULL(r.tickets_total,0) AS delta_tickets,ISNULL(ds.detalle_pax,0)-ISNULL(r.pax_total,0) AS delta_pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime r LEFT JOIN ds ON ds.fecha_operacion=r.fecha_operacion WHERE r.unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-14' ORDER BY r.fecha_operacion

queries.name: origen_oct01_14_total_delta
queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT fecha_operacion,numero_ticket,SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(importe_neto,0) ELSE 0 END) AS venta_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-14' GROUP BY fecha_operacion,numero_ticket), ds AS (SELECT SUM(venta_ticket) AS detalle_ventas,COUNT(*) AS detalle_tickets FROM d), r AS (SELECT SUM(ventas_total) AS runtime_ventas,SUM(tickets_total) AS runtime_tickets FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-14') SELECT CAST(r.runtime_ventas AS decimal(18,2)) AS runtime_ventas,r.runtime_tickets,CAST(ds.detalle_ventas AS decimal(18,2)) AS detalle_ventas,ds.detalle_tickets,CAST(ds.detalle_ventas-r.runtime_ventas AS decimal(18,2)) AS delta_ventas,ds.detalle_tickets-r.runtime_tickets AS delta_tickets FROM r CROSS JOIN ds
